name: Read
author: akramboussanni@users.noreply.github.com
description: Read, the teacher-guided Arabic course, in one server. PostgreSQL runs inside the container with its data in /home/container unless DATABASE_URL is set. Starts in demo mode (shared demo student and teacher, no setup); switch READ_MODE to authentik for school accounts. With a Cloudflare Tunnel, set its public hostname service to http://localhost:8080; no allocation is needed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Application is bundled in the yolk; no download required."

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Address people open, with no trailing slash, e.g. https://read.example.org. Sign-in links and redirects use it.

variables.name: Sign-in mode
variables.description: demo: two shared accounts (Yasmine, student; Mme Haddad, teacher) and a demo class with code DEMO01, reseeded on every start, no setup. authentik: school accounts through Authentik; fill the four Authentik fields below.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
variables.description: Token from a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel. Set its public hostname service to http://localhost:8080. Empty disables the tunnel and serves Read on the allocation port instead, which then requires an allocation.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Leave empty to run PostgreSQL inside the container, with its data in postgres/. To use an external server instead: postgres://USER:URL_ENCODED_PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DB.

variables.name: Auth secret
variables.description: Signs sessions. Leave empty to generate one on first start, kept in .auth-secret. Changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: Authentik client ID
variables.description: authentik mode only. Client ID of the Read provider in Authentik.

variables.name: Authentik client secret
variables.description: authentik mode only. Client secret of the same provider.

variables.name: Authentik issuer
variables.description: authentik mode only. Exact issuer from the provider's OpenID configuration, e.g. https://auth.example.org/application/o/read/.

variables.name: Teacher group
variables.description: authentik mode only. Authentik group whose members get the teacher role; everyone else is a student.

variables.name: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: Optional. Enables fresh review sentences, the daily story and open-answer grading. Without it Read uses reviewed content only.

variables.name: OpenRouter model
variables.description: Model used when the key is set.
